_spec: Stage 6 golden, written from docs/reviews/ipo-pipeline-stage-gap-analysis.md section 6 row 6 ('Persist extracted data | stage-5 JSON | createFinancialData etc. through upsertIPO precedence | rows in financial_data / peer_companies; field_sources = RHP') BEFORE this stage was run. Row 6's 'Exists today?' cell already says NO (functions exist, no precedence, no confidence), so several expectations below are RED BY DESIGN and are marked `redByDesign` with the spec line they come from. This harness does NOT implement stage 6 (issue #258 scope: 'Out of scope: building stage 6 persistence-precedence logic itself').
_input: fixtures/stage-6/stage-5-output-deepa.json is the REAL stage-5 output: scraper/scripts/extract_financials_pdf.py run on the real Deepa Jewellers RHP page text (fixtures/stage-5/deepa-rhp-pages.json). Per the ladder, a stage is green only when its output feeds the next stage's fixture unchanged, so this file is stage 5's output byte-for-byte, not a hand-written stand-in.

input.conversion: the DB stores INR crore (schema.ts financial_data comment); extractor emits INR million, so crore = million / 10

expectedWrite._note: The single row createFinancialData must hand to FinancialDataRepository.upsert for the input above, in INR crore.

expectedPrecedence._spec_line: section 6 row 6 runs column: 'through upsertIPO precedence'; field-priority order ADMIN > DRHP > NSE > BSE > ... (CLAUDE.md, field-priority-matrix.ts)
expectedPrecedence.case: an existing financial_data value whose field_sources.source is ADMIN must survive an RHP-sourced write of the same field
expectedPrecedence.expectedOutcome: keep the ADMIN value, record the rejected incoming value in field_sources.previous_value

redByDesign.claim: createFinancialData writes field_sources rows naming the document source
redByDesign.observedToday: scraper/src/services/data-persister.ts createFinancialData (line ~1815) builds a FinancialDataInsert and calls financialDataRepository.upsert only; FieldSourcesRepository is never touched on this path

redByDesign.claim: the scraper_source enum can express an RHP-sourced field
redByDesign.observedToday: packages/shared/src/db/schema.ts scraperSourceEnum = [ADMIN, DRHP, NSE, BSE, API_FALLBACK, MONEYCONTROL, CHITTORGARH] - there is no RHP value, so an RHP-extracted field cannot be labelled correctly at all

redByDesign.claim: a higher-precedence existing value (ADMIN) survives a lower-precedence RHP write
redByDesign.observedToday: createFinancialData does an unconditional upsert - it never reads the existing row, never consults FIELD_PRIORITY_MATRIX, and has no confidence input

redByDesign.claim: the persist door can store the fiscal years the document actually reports
redByDesign.observedToday: ScrapedFinancialData and financial_data hard-code FY2022/FY2023/FY2024 columns; the real Deepa RHP reports FY2026/FY2025/FY2024, so two of its three years have nowhere to go and are silently dropped
